offering_description.value: Owns and leases fiber and copper communications networks to telecom carriers, and sells broadband internet service to residential and business customers in rural US markets. Network capacity is leased under long-term contracts and retail service is sold on monthly subscriptions.

primary_products.value: fiber network capacity; dark fiber; copper network access; broadband internet

primary_services.value: network leasing; fiber construction and maintenance; managed network connectivity

customer_segment.value: B2B: wireless carriers, telecom operators, enterprises, data centers; B2C: residential broadband subscribers in rural areas

end_markets.value: telecommunications; wireless; enterprise connectivity; residential broadband

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: long-term leases of fiber and copper network assets to carriers; subscription: monthly broadband internet subscriptions; service fees: network construction, maintenance and connectivity services
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs fiber and copper networks, sold as leased capacity to carriers; service provider: sells broadband internet service to households and businesses

geography_served.value: US national: fiber and copper network assets across many US states, with retail broadband concentrated in rural southern and central states

specialization.value: related lines: network infrastructure leasing and retail broadband service sharing the same fiber and copper network

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts with carriers and enterprise customers; online: online sign-up and account management for broadband subscribers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: telecom carrier rules from the FCC and state utility commissions, plus REIT tax rules for the real estate structure

notes: Name matches Uniti Group Inc. at uniti.com; the description reflects the business after its 2025 merger with Windstream, which may be incompletely reflected.
